// A switch over a union that forgot two members, guarded by a `never` check.
type Status = "draft" | "review" | "published" | "archived";

export function label(status: Status): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "draft":
      return "Draft";
    case "published":
      return "Live";
    default: {
      const unhandled: never = status;
      return unhandled;
    }
  }
}
